name: spoken-alerts
description: Speaks two alerts with Mac, OpenAI or ElevenLabs voices: when work ends, the project, the thread and what was done; when Claude asks you something, a chime, the question and the recommended option.

provider.title: Voice provider
provider.description: mac speaks with the Mac's own voices (free, offline). openai and elevenlabs need that provider's API key; if the cloud voice fails, the Mac voice speaks.

doneVoice.title: Work-done voice
doneVoice.description: Empty: Samantha (Mac), onyx (OpenAI), Sarah (ElevenLabs). Otherwise a Mac voice name, an OpenAI voice name or an ElevenLabs voice ID, for the provider you chose.

questionVoice.title: Question voice
questionVoice.description: Empty: Daniel (Mac), nova (OpenAI), George (ElevenLabs). Otherwise a voice for the provider you chose.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Needed for the openai provider. Kept in secure storage. Empty: OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment, then from ~/.claude/.env.

elevenlabsApiKey.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabsApiKey.description: Needed for the elevenlabs provider. Kept in secure storage. Empty: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the environment, then from ~/.claude/.env.
